```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id (weak inversion -> large area)
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # long pair L for low flicker
    "I1":    (22e-6, 10e-6, 40e-6),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidp": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # low gm/Id on load -> smaller gm3/gm1 noise share
    "I7":    (220e-6, 100e-6, 350e-6),
    "Cc":    (2.2e-12, 1.0e-12, 3.5e-12),
    "kRz":   (1.6, 0.8, 4.0),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidn": (14.5, 10.0, 17.0),     # more tail headroom
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1 = p["I1"]; Itail = 2 * I1; I7 = p["I7"]; Cc = p["Cc"]

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.8)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Itail, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    gm7 = m6.gm
    Rz = p["kRz"] / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "d2", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "d2", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm7 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + C1 * cl + cl * Cc))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m1.cgd))
    den = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / gm7)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * den) if den > 0 else 1e15
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    power = (iref + Itail + I7) * 1.8
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    # flicker calibrated to iter-1 sim (421 nV @ gmid14,L1,19uA pair; gmid10,L0.8 load)
    r1 = lut.size("n", 14.0, 1.0, 18.7e-6, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    r3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, 0.8, 18.7e-6, vds=0.8)
    A1r = r1.W * r1.L; A3r = r3.W * r3.L
    A1 = m1.W * m1.L; A3 = m3.W * m3.L
    # split ref flicker^2: ~60% diff pair, ~40% load (scaled by (gm3/gm1)^2)
    f0 = 4.1e-7 ** 2
    k1 = 0.6 * f0 * A1r
    k3 = 0.4 * f0 * A3r / (r3.gm / r1.gm) ** 2
    nf2 = k1 / A1 + k3 / A3 * (m3.gm / gm1) ** 2
    noise = math.sqrt(noise_th ** 2 + nf2)
    swing = 1.8 - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.2
    slew = 0.7 * min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8)
    cmrr = db(2 * a1 * m3.gm / max(m5.gds, 1e-12)) - 6
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise,
               "psrr_db": gain_db - 5, "cmrr_db": min(cmrr, gain_db)}
```
